title: Automating Design-to-Code Sync for FinTech Dashboards
business: A mid-sized financial services firm maintaining a complex customer-facing dashboard.
problem: Front-end engineers frequently struggle with design drift, where implemented UI components deviate from Figma design tokens and layout specifications, leading to inconsistent user experiences and manual reconciliation efforts.
solution: By integrating the Figma MCP server, the engineering team enables Claude to directly query design tokens, component metadata, and layout structures. This allows the AI to generate code that strictly adheres to existing design patterns and Code Connect mappings, ensuring the implementation matches the design intent without manual translation.
steps: Authenticate the Figma MCP server within the development environment using the provided connector URL.
Use get_code_connect_map to retrieve existing component definitions and their corresponding code implementations.
Invoke get_design_context on specific Figma frames to extract layout variables and styling properties.
Generate the initial UI component code using the retrieved design context and Code Connect mappings.
Utilize generate_diagram to visualize the component state transitions in FigJam for stakeholder review.
outcome: The team achieves higher consistency between design and production code, reducing the time spent on styling corrections and alignment meetings.
limitation: The connector relies on the accuracy of the Code Connect mappings; if the Figma design system is not correctly linked to the codebase, the generated code may reference non-existent or outdated component properties. Users should verify the output against the local component library to ensure compatibility.
